name: Zaman Oteli - Time Hotel
summary:
Time has left its traces inside this hotel. Pick up a mysterious lens, examine forgotten objects, and uncover the story hidden behind locked doors.

Zaman Oteli - Time Hotel is a single-player VR puzzle adventure built around hands-on exploration. Turn mechanisms, connect clues and use the lens to reveal details concealed in the present. Each solved puzzle takes you deeper into Leyla’s story.

SEVEN CONNECTED CHAPTERS
